currentCanonicalGoal.title: Einzelimpulse und Gesamtimpuls auf einer Geraden bestimmen
currentCanonicalGoal.titleEn: Determine individual and total momentum along a line
currentCanonicalGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann für zwei Körper, die sich auf derselben Geraden bewegen oder ruhen, eine positive Richtung wählen, aus ihren gegebenen Massen und Geschwindigkeiten zu einem gemeinsamen Zeitpunkt die vorzeichenbehafteten Einzelimpulse bestimmen und diese zum Gesamtimpuls addieren.
currentCanonicalGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can choose a positive direction for two objects at rest or moving along the same straight line, use their given masses and velocities at the same instant to determine their signed momenta, and add them to find the total momentum.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Einzelimpulse und Gesamtimpuls auf einer Geraden bestimmen
resourceLinks.description: Visualisierung zum Lernziel: Einzelimpulse und Gesamtimpuls auf einer Geraden bestimmen.
resourceLinks.altText: Zwei Wagen von je 1 kg fahren gleichzeitig auf einer Geraden. Rechts ist positiv. Links fährt ein Wagen mit +3 m/s nach rechts, rechts fährt der andere mit −1 m/s nach links. Ihre Impulse ergeben zusammen +2 kg·m/s.

atomicityReviews.reason: Axis choice, two individual momenta and their addition produce one common-time momentum total; they are necessary steps of one construction.
independentlyAssessableFacets: Construct and interpret the signed total momentum of two collinear bodies at one instant.

atomicityReviews.reason: The axis and two individual products are necessary steps in constructing one directed total for a single snapshot. Splitting them here would separate the calculation from its sign convention.
independentlyAssessableFacets: Determine and interpret the signed total momentum of two collinear objects at one instant.

semanticKindReviews.reason: The content defines a transferable physical momentum construction, rather than navigation or a particular practice item.
The signed composition of momenta can be taught and demonstrated across different two-body states.

currentPrerequisiteReviews.reason: The direct list and complete 21-node closure provide the product entry anchor and signed rational arithmetic without embedding the target. The orientation is an entry contract, not Physics mastery. Given velocity interpretation can be taught here; a compulsory speed-measurement experiment is unnecessary.

The direct mathematics goals supply signed addition, subtraction, multiplication and division. Their closure provides number and sign conventions. The Physics motivation anchor serves the stated entry contract. Masses, velocities and directions are given, so mastery of a speed-measurement experiment adds no required input. The physical association p = mv is taught here.

currentCanonicalGoal.title: Mittlere resultierende Kraft aus der Impulsänderung bestimmen
currentCanonicalGoal.titleEn: Determine the average net force from a change in momentum
currentCanonicalGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann für einen Körper fester Masse auf einer Geraden in einem Inertialsystem aus zwei gegebenen vorzeichenbehafteten Impulswerten und ihren Zeitpunkten die mittlere resultierende äußere Kraft im Intervall als $\Delta p/\Delta t$ berechnen. Sie gibt das Ergebnis in Newton an und deutet sein Vorzeichen bezogen auf die gewählte positive Richtung.
currentCanonicalGoal.descriptionEn: For a body of fixed mass moving along a line in an inertial frame, the learner can use two given signed momentum values and their times to calculate the average net external force over the interval as $\Delta p/\Delta t$. The learner gives the result in newtons and interprets its sign relative to the chosen positive direction.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Mittlere resultierende Kraft aus der Impulsänderung bestimmen
resourceLinks.description: Visualisierung zum Lernziel: Mittlere resultierende Kraft aus der Impulsänderung bestimmen.
resourceLinks.altText: Derselbe Wagen hat bei 1 s den Impuls +3 kg·m/s nach rechts und bei 3 s den Impuls −1 kg·m/s nach links. Rechts ist positiv. Die Änderung −4 kg·m/s in 2 s ergibt eine mittlere resultierende Kraft von −2 N.

atomicityReviews.reason: Computing the interval quotient and interpreting its sign and unit form one physical average-rate competence.
independentlyAssessableFacets: Determine and interpret average net external force from two timed momentum values.

atomicityReviews.reason: The time ordering, subtraction, division, unit and direction all characterize the same interval-average force.
independentlyAssessableFacets: Infer the signed average net external force from a body's two timed momenta.

semanticKindReviews.reason: The content defines a general physical average-rate relationship with interpretation.
Interpreting an interval momentum change as an average force is a transferable physical relationship, including in views that use it for preparation.

currentPrerequisiteReviews.reason: The complete 24-node closure supplies signed momentum through IMP and signed changes, positive elapsed time, quotient units and average interpretation through the rate prerequisite. IMP's additional two-body sum is broader than this one-body use, but is justified by its current teaching role and does not require restructuring. No target embedding was found.

IMP supplies signed single-body momentum and axis choice. Its two-body sum is extra preparation for this particular calculation, but removing the edge would also remove the current teaching place for signed momentum. The other direct goal supplies differences over positive intervals, units and the meaning of an average. The body and frame are stipulated. Interpreting this specific rate as net external force remains the new physics.

currentCanonicalGoal.title: Momentane resultierende Kraft aus der Steigung im Impuls-Zeit-Diagramm bestimmen
currentCanonicalGoal.titleEn: Determine the instantaneous net force from the slope of a momentum–time graph
currentCanonicalGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann für eine geradlinige Bewegung eines Körpers fester Masse in einem Inertialsystem die Tangentensteigung am Impuls-Zeit-Graphen als momentane resultierende äußere Kraft $F_{\mathrm{res}}(t)=\mathrm{d}p/\mathrm{d}t$ deuten und ihren Wert am markierten Zeitpunkt aus einer eingezeichneten Tangente mit Vorzeichen und Einheit näherungsweise bestimmen.
currentCanonicalGoal.descriptionEn: For a body of fixed mass moving along a line in an inertial frame, the learner can interpret the tangent slope on a signed momentum–time graph as the instantaneous net external force $F_{\mathrm{net}}(t)=\mathrm{d}p/\mathrm{d}t$ and use a drawn tangent to estimate its value at a marked time, with sign and unit.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Momentane resultierende Kraft aus der Steigung im Impuls-Zeit-Diagramm bestimmen
resourceLinks.description: Visualisierung zum Lernziel: Momentane resultierende Kraft aus der Steigung im Impuls-Zeit-Diagramm bestimmen.
resourceLinks.altText: Impuls-Zeit-Diagramm mit fallender Impulskurve. Bei t = 2 s und p = 2 kg·m/s berührt die gestrichelte Tangente die Kurve. Auf der Tangente fällt p von 4 auf 0 kg·m/s zwischen 1 und 3 s. Ihre Steigung ergibt die momentane resultierende Kraft −2 N bei 2 s.

atomicityReviews.reason: Reading a provided tangent and interpreting its slope as instantaneous force are coordinated parts of one representation competence.
independentlyAssessableFacets: Translate a momentum-graph tangent slope into instantaneous net force.

atomicityReviews.reason: Reading the tangent and interpreting its slope as a force are the graphical and physical parts of one estimate at a specified time.
independentlyAssessableFacets: Translate a drawn p(t) tangent into an instantaneous net force with direction and unit.

semanticKindReviews.reason: The content defines a reusable graph-to-force understanding competence.
The graph-to-force interpretation applies to a family of differentiable momentum curves and marked times.

currentPrerequisiteReviews.reason: The complete 40-node closure combines finite-interval physical momentum rate with tangent slope and derivative meaning. It prepares the graphical instantaneous estimate without presupposing that target. No missing canonical node or target embedding was found.

RATE-M supplies the finite-interval physical comparison. The mathematics goal on derivatives as point slopes brings graph reading, secants, difference quotients and the tangent concept through its closure. The new step is to read a local momentum slope as force. Symbolic differentiation of a fitted function is unnecessary.

currentCanonicalGoal.title: Newtons 2. Axiom (Grundgleichung der Mechanik)
currentCanonicalGoal.titleEn: Newton's Second Law (Fundamental Equation of Mechanics)
currentCanonicalGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Newtons zweites Axiom für einen Körper konstanter Masse in einem Inertialsystem formulieren und erklären, dass der Betrag der Beschleunigung dem Betrag der resultierenden äußeren Kraft geteilt durch die Masse entspricht und eine von null verschiedene Beschleunigung in Richtung dieser Kraft zeigt.
currentCanonicalGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can state Newton’s second law for an object of constant mass in an inertial frame and explain that the magnitude of its acceleration equals the magnitude of the net external force divided by the mass, and that any nonzero acceleration points in the direction of that force.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Newtons 2. Axiom (Grundgleichung der Mechanik)
resourceLinks.description: Visualisierung zum Lernziel: Newtons 2. Axiom (Grundgleichung der Mechanik).
resourceLinks.altText: Ein Wagen mit der konstanten Masse 2 kg. Die resultierende äußere Kraft von 6 N und die Beschleunigung von 3 m/s² zeigen nach rechts. Darunter steht 6 N = 2 kg · 3 m/s².

atomicityReviews.reason: Magnitude, mass dependence and direction express one vector law rather than separate competencies requiring a split.
independentlyAssessableFacets: Explain the constant-mass relationship between net external force and acceleration.

atomicityReviews.reason: Force scaling, inverse mass dependence, direction and the zero case are consequences of the same constant-mass vector equation.
independentlyAssessableFacets: Explain how a given net force and constant mass determine acceleration in an inertial frame.

semanticKindReviews.reason: The content concerns explanation of a physical law, not merely its recall card or an assessment instance.
The goal asks for the physical meaning and consequences of a law. Its formula can also support a separate recall task.

currentPrerequisiteReviews.reason: The first-law route and complete 56-node closure provide inertia, resultant force, velocity and acceleration. The inherited preparation is broader than the concise conceptual target but is a defensible instructional sequence. The target is not embedded, and the current Newton2 goal teaches F=ma rather than dp/dt.

Newton I establishes inertial-frame and zero-resultant reasoning. Its closure already includes acceleration, directed motion, qualitative force effects, units and proportional relationships. The magnitude and direction of acceleration for a nonzero resultant remain to be learned. Applying the equation to numerical dynamics problems is a successor.

currentCanonicalGoal.title: Impulserhaltung
currentCanonicalGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann in einem abgegrenzten System ohne resultierenden äußeren Kraftstoß den Gesamtimpuls als vektorielle Erhaltungsgröße nutzen und einfache Rückstoßsituationen damit qualitativ begründen.
currentCanonicalGoal.descriptionEn: In a defined system with no net external impulse, the learner can use total momentum as a conserved vector quantity and apply it to qualitatively justify simple recoil situations.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Impulserhaltung
resourceLinks.altText: Didaktische Visualisierung zum Lernziel "Impulserhaltung". Die lernende Person kann in einem abgegrenzten System ohne resultierenden äußeren Kraftstoß den Gesamtimpuls als vektorielle Erhaltungsgröße nutzen und einfache Rückstoßsituationen damit qualitativ begründen.

atomicityReviews.reason: System selection, momentum balance and qualitative recoil explanation apply the same conservation relationship. The local wording correction does not reveal a separate proof competence.
independentlyAssessableFacets: Use total-momentum balance to explain a simple recoil interaction.

atomicityReviews.reason: Choosing the interacting bodies and comparing their endpoint totals supplies one qualitative explanation of recoil. Solving for an unknown velocity is separable and need not be a required facet.
independentlyAssessableFacets: Justify simple recoil with the total momentum balance for the chosen bodies.

semanticKindReviews.reason: The content defines simple conservation-based recoil reasoning applicable across contexts.
Using a system balance to explain recoil is an identifiable understanding competence across multiple contexts.

currentPrerequisiteReviews.reason: The direct requirements and complete 61-node closure prepare signed total momentum, force balance and interaction forces acting on different bodies. These support simple system-boundary and recoil reasoning. The advanced differential/integral proof and RATE-I are not necessary prerequisites for this goal.

IMP supplies the signed sum. Applying Newton III prepares the distinction between an interaction pair on two bodies and forces on one body, and its closure already includes the conceptual Newton II goal. The additional gate requiring application of ΣF = ma to accelerated motion contributes no quantity or inference needed for this qualitative endpoint comparison. The external-impulse condition can be introduced through the system boundary here. The formal impulse goal is downstream.

currentCanonicalGoal.title: Impulserhaltung aus Newtonschen Axiomen (LK)
currentCanonicalGoal.titleEn: Momentum Conservation from Newton's Laws (Advanced Course)
currentCanonicalGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann in einem Inertialsystem für ein materiell abgeschlossenes System aus Newtons zweitem und drittem Axiom herleiten, dass der Gesamtimpuls bei verschwindendem resultierendem äußerem Kraftstoß an den Intervallgrenzen gleich ist, und die Voraussetzungen für seine fortlaufende Erhaltung diskutieren.
currentCanonicalGoal.descriptionEn: In an inertial frame, the learner can derive from Newton's second and third laws that total momentum has equal values at the interval boundaries in a materially closed system when the net external impulse is zero and discuss the conditions for its continuous conservation.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Impulserhaltung aus Newtonschen Axiomen (LK)
resourceLinks.description: Visualisierung zum Lernziel: Impulserhaltung aus Newtonschen Axiomen (LK).
resourceLinks.altText: Didaktische Visualisierung zum Lernziel "Impulserhaltung aus Newtonschen Axiomen (LK)". Die lernende Person kann in einem Inertialsystem für ein materiell abgeschlossenes System aus Newtons zweitem und drittem Axiom herleiten, dass der Gesamtimpuls bei verschwindendem resultierendem äußerem Kraftstoß erhalten bleibt, und die Voraussetzungen dieser Herleitung diskutieren.

atomicityReviews.reason: The derivation and the distinction between its endpoint and continuous consequences constitute one theorem with its validity conditions.
independentlyAssessableFacets: Derive the total-momentum balance from Newton's laws and delimit its conservation consequences.

atomicityReviews.reason: Cancellation, the differential balance and its time integral form one proof. Distinguishing its instantaneous and interval conclusions establishes when the derived statement holds.
independentlyAssessableFacets: Derive and interpret the system momentum balance from Newton II and III under stated conditions.

semanticKindReviews.reason: The content defines a physical derivation and its validity conditions, rather than a named examination task.
Deriving a physical law for a system and identifying its validity conditions is a teachable proof competence. It remains applicable when the system boundary or external force history changes.

currentPrerequisiteReviews.reason: The complete 83-node closure supplies Newton applications, vector addition, integral interpretation and explicitly RATE-I. RATE-I supplies the momentum-derivative relationship absent from the narrowed Newton2 goal. Together these prepare summation, integration and endpoint/continuous distinctions without embedding the proof target.

The direct laws-of-motion applications prepare body-by-body force accounting and identification of action–reaction pairs. RATE-I now supplies the single-body dp/dt relation, with signed momentum and RATE-M in its closure. The vector and integral branches supply component sums, signed accumulation and the fundamental theorem. Together they support the proof without assuming its conclusion. Its LK placement requires those mathematics prerequisites to be available when it is taught.
